title: A New World
text: Ships back from the western ocean bring parrots, gold rings and strange stories: islands, endless forests, rivers wider than any in Europe, and peoples no Christian has ever seen. Every crown with an ocean coast is already counting the colonists it could send.

title: The Council of the Indies
text: Gold, parrots and baptized captives have come back from across the ocean, and every hidalgo without an inheritance wants a ship. The crown can take the new lands in hand: a council in Seville to license every voyage, collect the royal fifth and send settlers west.
news: Castile founds a Council of the Indies to rule its lands across the ocean.

choices.text: Found the Council of the Indies
